description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the Thunder::Core namespace, including its methods, nested classes, and data members. It provides an interface for a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer management functionalities, intended for inter-process communication and data sharing.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class providing a shared, process-wide cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer management capabilities for inter-process data sharing.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested class within CyclicBuffer used for peeking and managing positions within the buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with a filename, mode, size, and overwrite flag.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(Core::DataElementFile& buffer, const bool initiator, const uint32_t offset, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with an existing DataElementFile object.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the cyclic buffer for access.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Reads data non-destructively from the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and consumes data from the buffer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Notifies that data is available in the buffer.
